home.body: Your second brain is being built. As you connect sources and Codex sorts your history, this page fills with links to your people, companies, projects and everything else worth remembering.

refuseOverwrite: "{vault}" already exists and is not a Confidant vault. Refusing to write into it. Pass --resume only for an existing Confidant vault, or choose a different --vault path.
resumeMissing: --resume was set but "{vault}" is not a Confidant vault yet. Run init without --resume first.
